Local._modelComment: When AutoSelectModel is true, the first PreferredModels entry that Foundry Local has loaded is used instead of ModelId. Load one with: foundry model run phi-4-mini
Local._comment: To use Ollama instead, change Endpoint to http://localhost:11434/v1 and ModelId to llama3.2:3b or phi3

Summarization._comment: Documents longer than MaxSinglePassTokens (~4 chars/token) are read in parts and summarized from per-part notes. Raise it for models with larger context windows.

Chat._comment: Each chat question is sent with only the most relevant document passages (up to MaxPassageTokens) plus the last MaxHistoryTurns exchanges. Documents smaller than MaxPassageTokens are sent whole.

Cloud._comment: To use OpenAI directly, change Endpoint to https://api.openai.com/v1 and set your API key
